label: sec:lepton-anomalies-data
html:
Existing data sets.

  • Muon g-2 results from BNL E821 and Fermilab E989.
  • LHCb R_K and R_{K^*} measurements of lepton flavour universality.
  • Belle II early data on B-meson decays.

Planned observations.

  • Full Belle II data set (\sim50 ab^{-1} integrated luminosity): precision tests of lepton universality in \tau decays.
  • HL-LHC (High-Luminosity LHC): extended reach for rare lepton flavour violating processes.

Potential new experiments.

  • Electron--muon scattering experiments (e.g. MUonE at CERN) to test q-dependent corrections to the electromagnetic vertex directly.
